One Love

One Love brings tropical vibes & reggae rhythms to your event, blending soul, pop & sunshine-soaked hits into a feel-good party you’ll never forget.

About One Love

One Love is the ultimate feel-good party band delivering reggae, soul, and pop sunshine straight to your event—whatever the weather. With two dynamic lineups (5-piece or 6-piece including brass &amp; rap), they tailor their performance to your vibe, whether it’s all-out reggae or a genre-spanning celebration. The band is led by powerhouse vocalist Aisha , whose rich, soulful tone has lit up stages from The Royal Albert Hall to Wembley . She’s joined by guitarist-vocalist Jules , a genre-spanning pro who’s performed with Boy George and Sinead O’Connor , and multi-talented Zeb , who raps and switches effortlessly between trombone and trumpet , bringing serious brass brilliance. From Bob Marley to Aretha Franklin , their extensive 360+ song repertoire includes reggae, soul, pop, funk, rock, and more. With full PA and lighting , friendly professionalism, and years of elite experience, One Love guarantees a vibrant, crowd-pleasing show from first note to final encore.
